nodeGroups.name: Apply status change
nodeGroups.description: Takes a cancel, check-in or completed call, updates the appointment row, replies and logs; failures email an alert

nodeGroups.name: Process SMS replies
nodeGroups.description: Reads patient texts such as STOP or START, stores the consent change, answers with a confirmation and logs it

nodeGroups.name: Find due appointments
nodeGroups.description: Every 15 minutes, lists due reminders, no-shows and rebookings, then re-checks each live row for status, check-in and consent

nodeGroups.name: Act on due appointments
nodeGroups.description: Marks verified no-shows, drafts SMS with AI or a fixed template, previews it in dry run or sends it once, then logs and alerts
